title: Server Deployed
message: Connected server is live and accepting connections.

title: API & Cross-Origin Connectivity Restored
message: Resolved an issue preventing cross-origin requests from completing successfully on the API health endpoint. Full service connectivity has been restored.

title: DNS & Domain Routing Configured
message: Domain routing and DNS configuration have been successfully updated for vault.observer and api.vault.observer.

title: Root Domain Routing & 404 Behavior Updated
message: Resolved an issue where root domain routing served status dashboard content on the root path. Root domain routing has been updated to enforce standard 404 behavior, isolating health status monitoring exclusively to /health.

title: Health Dashboard Redirection Loop Resolved
message: Resolved a routing issue that caused a temporary redirection loop (ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS) when accessing the health dashboard at /health. Clean URL routing rules have been updated and normal accessibility is restored.
